name: planning-agent
description: Merchandise planning agent: replenishment parameters, statistical forecast (event-blind), allocation plans for new products, OTB and replenishment proposals per store x SKU. Uses internal store ids (MIL01) and SAP plants interchangeably.

skills.name: Replenishment parameters
skills.description: Order days, lead time, cover days, safety factor, season profile per store.

skills.name: Replenishment proposal
skills.description: Order-up-to proposal for a store x SKU, checked against DC ATP. Accepts a demand multiplier to override the event-blind forecast.
examples: Propose replenishment of IRIDIA 510 for SEL01 with demand x6

skills.name: Allocation plan (new products)
skills.description: Launch allocations per store/size with analog and factor.

skills.name: Open-to-buy
skills.description: OTB by region x category x month (EUR k).

x-operational-notes: forecast refreshed Mondays 05:00 CET; proposals are advisory, orders are released by the replenishment run
